items.question: How much does a long distance move cost?
items.answer: Long distance moving costs depend on the weight of your shipment, distance, and services needed. Most interstate moves from Vancouver/Portland range from $3,000 to $8,000. We provide free binding estimates so you know the exact cost before moving day.

items.question: How long does a long distance move take?
items.answer: Transit times depend on the distance. Moves within the West Coast typically take 3–5 days. Cross-country moves to the East Coast take 7–14 days. We give you a delivery window and keep you updated throughout.

items.question: Are my belongings insured during the move?
items.answer: Yes. Every long distance move includes basic carrier liability at $0.60 per pound per item. We also offer full-value protection plans that cover the replacement value of your belongings. Ask us for details during your estimate.

items.question: Do you store items if my new home isn’t ready?
items.answer: Yes. We offer short-term and long-term storage in our secure, climate-controlled warehouse. Your items stay on our inventory and are delivered whenever you’re ready.

items.question: What can’t you move long distance?
items.answer: Federal regulations prohibit us from transporting hazardous materials, perishable food, plants, and live animals. We’ll provide a full list of non-allowable items before your move.
